question: If you enroll in Medicare Part B late without qualifying coverage, how long does the late enrollment penalty usually last?
true_option: For as long as you have Part B — it's generally a lifetime penalty
false_option: For 12 months, after which it drops off
true_claim_text: the Part B late enrollment penalty generally lasts for as long as you have Part B
false_claim_text: the Part B late penalty drops off after 12 months
source: CMS / Medicare.gov, Part B late enrollment penalty: your monthly premium may go up 10% for each full 12-month period you could have had Part B but didn't sign up, and you usually pay the penalty for as long as you have Part B.
